title: Attacks You Can Use Mid-Jump
intro: Every MapleStory Classic attack you can use while jumping, sorted by class, with third job listed separately. Checked against the game's own files.

blocks.p: [[img:eead4ba441ad89.png]] Every thief attack in MapleStory Classic World can be used mid-jump, and so can both first-job warrior attacks. Bowmen's only mid-jump attack is Power Knockback. Magicians get Heal.
We checked all 116 active skills from the second Closed Online Test (August 2026) and the August 11 balance update.

blocks.h2: Which attacks can you use while jumping?

blocks.p: Every first and second job attack you can start in the air, sorted by class. Jump first, then press the skill.

table: 130% damage to up to 4 monsters around you; costs 8 HP
Lowers Speed and Weapon DEF of up to 4 monsters for 30 sec
Heals you and nearby party members; solo, damages up to 5 undead monsters
180% damage to up to 4 monsters and knocks them back; always a critical hit
Throws 2 stars for 140% damage, based on LUK
Lowers one monster's Attack and Weapon DEF for 30 sec; deals 100% weapon damage
240% damage; 12% chance to absorb 15% of it as HP
Up to 6 hits at 75% damage each
180% damage to up to 2 monsters; 90% chance to steal an item

blocks.p: Third job isn't available at launch. Nexon's August 21 report says it won't be in Founder's Access or the Grand Launch (release date guide). Everything in this section comes from the test build and is subject to change.
In the test build, these third job skills could be used mid-jump:
